title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11e — quality relocation bridge
goal: Let base-owned tests validate exactly one legacy or Post-stage Quality layout before the authorized physical relocation.
acceptanceCriteria: The current complete legacy Quality layout remains active and production entry points remain unchanged.
Assembly, Package and manifest tests select exactly one complete legacy or stage-owned layout.
Missing, partial or ambiguous Quality layouts fail closed.
The subsequent physical relocation removes the legacy directory without retaining a production fallback.
